STATEMENT OF WORK NO. 4

This Statement of Work is entered into as of April 14, 2026 under the Master Services Agreement between Larkspur Creative Group LLC ("Agency") and Halbrook Diagnostics, Inc. ("Client") dated June 3, 2025 (the "MSA"). Capitalized terms not defined here have the meanings given in the MSA. In the event of a conflict between this Statement of Work and the MSA, the MSA controls except as to the matters expressly addressed here.

1. SERVICES

Agency will design, produce, and traffic a paid media campaign for the launch of the Client's oncology assay panel, comprising:
  (a) a creative concept and three executions;
  (b) production of two 30-second videos and eight static assets;
  (c) media planning and buying across search, display, and trade publications; and
  (d) weekly performance reporting.

2. DELIVERABLES AND ACCEPTANCE

Deliverable D1 — Creative concept deck, due May 8, 2026.
Deliverable D2 — Final video masters and static assets, due June 12, 2026.
Deliverable D3 — Media plan with flighting and budget allocation, due June 19, 2026.
Deliverable D4 — Campaign performance report, weekly from July 6, 2026.

Client will accept or reject each Deliverable in writing within five (5) business days of delivery, stating the reason for any rejection with reference to the specification. A Deliverable not rejected within that period is accepted. Agency will correct a rejected Deliverable within ten (10) business days at no additional charge, and a Deliverable rejected twice for the same reason entitles Client to terminate this Statement of Work for cause and to a refund of amounts paid for it.

3. TERM

This Statement of Work begins on April 20, 2026 and ends on December 31, 2026 unless terminated earlier under the MSA.

4. FEES

Agency fee: $186,000, invoiced 30% on signature, 40% on acceptance of D2, and 30% on acceptance of D3.
Pass-through media: estimated $640,000, billed at actual net cost with vendor invoices, capped at $700,000 without Client's prior written approval.
Expenses: pre-approved travel at cost. No markup on any pass-through cost.

5. KEY PERSONNEL

Marcus Ellery Doyle (Creative Director) and Devon Achebe (Media Director) are Key Personnel. Agency will not replace either without Client's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and any replacement must have substantially equivalent experience.

6. CLIENT DEPENDENCIES

Client will provide brand assets, claim substantiation, and medical-legal-regulatory review within five (5) business days of request. A Deliverable date slips day-for-day for each day a dependency is late, and Agency will notify Client in writing when a dependency becomes overdue.

7. CHANGE CONTROL

A change to scope, fees, or a Deliverable date is effective only when both parties sign a written change order referencing this Statement of Work. Agency will not perform, and Client will not be charged for, out-of-scope work without one.

ACCEPTED:
